editorial:
Imagine being a world-class figure skater who is willing to do anything to get the best coach in the business. That is exactly where you find Katelin, a driven athlete with big Olympic dreams. To get close to a legendary Russian coach, she makes a wild bet and joins a girls hockey team to get a scholarship at a new school. You will love the fish-out-of-water vibe here, as Katelin goes from graceful glides to crashing into walls and dealing with teammates who do not trust her. It is a sweet, lighthearted story about fitting in and chasing your goals regardless of the cost.

The acting is charming and the pacing keeps things moving quickly, though the plot is pretty predictable. You will enjoy the funny clashes between the refined world of skating and the rough nature of hockey. If you are looking for a cozy movie night with the family, this is a great pick. It is a feel-good flick that does not ask too much of you but delivers plenty of smiles.
endingExplained: In the end, Katelin manages to balance her love for skating with her new respect for her hockey teammates. She performs a stunning routine that proves her hard work paid off and earns the respect of the coach she admired. After a lot of tension, she makes peace with the hockey girls and realizes that friendship is more important than just winning. Everything wraps up happily as she secures her future in skating while keeping her new friends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog sports stories and teen comedies.
